strings.name: Gabriel Boric
strings.summary: Boric moved from student activism to Congress and helped negotiate the 2019 constitutional-process agreement. President in 2022–2026, he pursued pension, labor and care reforms, while two constitutional drafts failed referendums. Pension reform became law in 2025 and care legislation passed in early 2026. He handed power to José Antonio Kast in March 2026.
